units.en: Base research cost represents the time it takes to research a specific technology. In practice, this cost will likely vary each time due to different research modifiers being applied (for better or for worse).
Research speed modifiers stack additively to research speed (rather than subtractively to research cost). For example, 110 days base cost at 15% research speed bonus will take:
"Days Saved" are subtracted from the modified expected number of days. Thus, "Days Saved" benefit from (or are penalized by) the same research speed modifiers.
The aggregate research bonus is calculated and updated every day. Thus changes in research speed (except limited-use bonuses) apply to all ongoing research.
Research speed cannot fall below 10% of the default speed.⟦0⟧
The player can get a research speed bonus or penalty depending on the game difficulty setting as follows:
Trade laws can also increase research speed. The more open the trade the higher the reduction as can be seen below.

Limited-use bonuses are awarded by ⟦0⟧. Once available, a limited-use research bonus is activated when a Research Slot is assigned to an applicable technology. Once activated, the limited-use bonus is tied to the technology even if the slot is re-assigned. However, the game does give a grace period of 3⟦1⟧ days to switch the bonus to a different applicable technology with the same slot.
A limited-use bonus can additionally act as an ⟦0⟧ bonus, reducing the ahead-of-time penalty by the stated amount.
Some ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ allow the player to spend ⟦2⟧ to acquire a one-time research speed bonus for them. These bonuses apply on top of any existing one-time bonuses that would be expended alongside them.

When licensing equipment from another country, researching that equipment gets a speed bonus of ⟦0⟧.⟦1⟧ For equipment that uses designs, such as ⟦2⟧ (with ), ⟦3⟧ (with ), and ⟦4⟧ (with ), the bonus only applies to technologies for the chassis, hulls, and airframes, not to any module technologies for components of the licensed design(s).

When a country is part of a research group, it gets a research speed bonus for each other country in the group that has already unlocked that technology, up to ⟦0⟧.⟦1⟧ Tech sharing bonus functions in the same way as Limited-use bonus: once applied, the bonus is locked to the tech; changes in the country's tech sharing situation will only reflect in future research. ⟦2⟧ can benefit less from technology sharing, depending on their ⟦3⟧ level.
Various ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, and ⟦2⟧ can continuously improve research speed for applicable technologies while they are active.
With ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧ can be assigned to perform research, providing a research speed bonus at the cost of daily ⟦2⟧.

All technologies have a date attached to them when they become current. Researching them earlier comes at the cost of reduced research speed. Each year ahead-of-time adds a ⟦0⟧ ahead-of-time (AOT) penalty.⟦1⟧ Ahead-of-time bonuses from ⟦2⟧ can reduce this penalty modifier. For research ahead of time, the in-game tool-tip displays the estimated time to completion using the formula below.

A technology starting to research ⟦0⟧ years before the date it becomes current, with a base research cost of ⟦1⟧ days and aggregate research bonus at ⟦2⟧ %, will take ⟦3⟧ days to complete, where ⟦4⟧ without any penalty reductions from ⟦5⟧. This assumes the research starts with a speed higher than the minimum and finishes before the technology becomes current. It is also subject to a small approximation error (unlikely to be noticed in-game). The formula is derived by solving the following integral equation for ⟦6⟧ (in days):

For example, at exactly one year before a tech becomes current, research speed on that tech is modified by multiplicative factor of ⟦0⟧ . As research speed is re-calculated every day, the speed penalty goes down while a technology is being researched. Half a year later, the penalty is down to ⟦1⟧ . Regular research speed modifiers apply linearly. Thus regular country-wide research bonus does not alleviate AOT penalties. If a 50% ahead-of-time bonus is active as shown in in-game tooltip, 0.5 is taken off the AOT penalty. Thus, at 1 year ahead-of-time, the research speed is modified by ⟦2⟧ instead of ⟦3⟧ without the bonus; similarly, at half a year ahead-of-time, the AOT penalty is reduced to ⟦4⟧ from ⟦5⟧ without bonus.

Below is a Python script to calculate the time it will take to research a technology, given its base cost, bonuses and AOT penalty.

res_perc = 0.0 time = 0 base = 170 # Base Cost bonus = 0.34 # Research Speed Bonus aot = 0.47 # Ahead-of-time penalty (not years ahead) base /= 1+bonus while res_perc<1: res_perc += 1/base/(1+aot) aot -= 2/365 if aot<0: aot = 0 time += 1 print(time) # Prints total time needed
